items.title: Fans Are 'Disappointed' Over Mariah Carey's 'Depressing' Gucci Holiday Campaign & 'Boring' Styling
items.summary: Report on negative social-media reaction to Gucci's Mariah Carey holiday film directed by Harmony Korine; viewers called the ad cold, dated, and unintentionally eerie rather than festive, with one commenter saying it "feels like if JCPenney was trying to be luxury." Styling drew some praise even as the overall concept was panned.

items.title: Mariah Carey Takes Christmas to Gucci for Holiday 2026
items.summary: Covers the launch of Gucci's 2026 holiday campaign starring Mariah Carey, directed by Harmony Korine, built around the new Butterfly special collection (Starlet, Gucci duffle, GG Marmont bags, suede Paparazzo bag) and set to 'All I Want for Christmas Is You.'

items.title: Gucci Sets Up New Business Units' Organization
items.summary: Gucci restructured into category-based business units (leather goods, women's and men's ready-to-wear, shoes) reporting to new chief product officer Marcello Costa, with Monica Ulmi and Marco Semeghini joining as senior advisers to support Demna's creative direction and tighten commercial execution.

items.title: Salma Hayek Wears Crimson Gucci Gown for LACMA Gala 2026 Red Carpet
items.summary: Salma Hayek Pinault wore a sequin-embellished crimson Gucci gown at the Nov. 7 LACMA Art+Film Gala, where Gucci continued its presenting sponsorship held since the gala's 2011 debut, part of a broader red-carpet push by Demna-era Gucci styling Kim Kardashian, Viola Davis and others.

items.title: At the LACMA Art+Film Gala 2026, Demna's Gucci Steps Into the Spotlight
items.summary: Roundup of Demna-designed Gucci looks worn by Rosie Huntington-Whiteley, Parker Posey, Kim Kardashian and others at the Nov. 7 LACMA gala, framing the heavy celebrity dressing push as part of Gucci's U.S. visibility strategy during its sales slump.

items.title: Kering's Gucci Turnaround Looks Further Away, Berenberg Says
items.summary: Berenberg cut its Kering price target to EUR165 from EUR175 and reiterated a Sell rating, citing Gucci Q3 retail sales down 9% (worse than the ~6% consensus), weak store traffic in China and the US, and 'little evidence' of a Q4 rebound; flags margin pressure from inventory clearance.

items.title: Tuesday's Digital Daily: November 10, 2026
items.summary: Daily WWD briefing noting continued Kering creative-leadership churn (Pierpaolo Piccioli's Balenciaga exit, Martine Rose starting Nov. 16) alongside the ongoing China-driven luxury slowdown affecting Gucci and group sales.

items.title: Mariah Carey Shines in Gucci's 2026 Holiday Campaign and Shares Festive Style Tips
items.summary: Entertainment-press coverage of the Mariah Carey x Gucci holiday campaign with styling details, presented more positively than the fan-reaction pieces, illustrating the split between press coverage and social sentiment.

items.source: X (Twitter) - fan/commentary posts referenced in press
items.title: Social posts calling Gucci holiday ad 'boring,' 'depressing,' 'outdated'
items.summary: Aggregated X/social commentary (quoted via press roundup) reacting to the Mariah Carey Gucci ad: "Cold is the perfect word"; "I would not attend that party. I'm scared"; comparisons of the ad's mood to a horror film rather than a holiday spot. No original post URLs independently located; sourced via secondary press aggregation, so treated as T3 opinion-thermometer signal.

items.title: Active Gucci forum threads this week: belt authentication, vintage archive finds, 2026 Flora
items.summary: PurseForum's Gucci subforum shows live activity this week including an authentication help thread for men's Gucci belts (posted this week) and a thread on an unknowingly purchased vintage Gucci archive piece (posted Saturday); general community traffic skews toward authentication/shopping help rather than brand controversy this cycle.
